scope.allocation_definition: One unique PBS scheduler allocation ID per record, deduplicated by job_id. The retained AI project PBS ledger has 124 records and every record requests one or more GPUs; all are in this H100 NSCC PBS track. This count is scheduler allocations, not benchmark points, concurrency points, repeats inferred from labels, or plan entries.
scope.lineage_rule: parent_job_ids includes only explicit source/control/baseline/original job identifiers or scheduler dependency references present in the retained config/ledger; no lineage is inferred from dates, naming, or proximity.
scope.started_rule: true requires retained collection, observed runtime, or positive estimated charge; false requires explicit evidence of cancellation before scheduler execution; null means the retained evidence did not establish either. No false values are assigned by inference.
scope.date_rule: Dates are submission dates where retained in submitted_utc; for the first ten legacy rows the dated README timeline establishes the calendar day. Date is null where no reliable retained date was found.
